guideContent.strategyOverview: This upgrade transforms the Necron Dynasties precon into a focused Bracket 3 artifact recursion powerhouse. Imotekh the Stormlord rewards you for artifacts leaving the graveyard with 2/2 Necron tokens. We're removing underperformers and adding sacrifice outlets, powerful recursion targets, and combo pieces that enable late-game infinite combos requiring 3+ pieces.

cutCategories.name: Underperformers
cutCategories.description: Cards that don't synergize well with artifact recursion or are too slow

full.name: Phaeron's Command
full.subtitle: Full Power
full.description: Maximum power within Bracket 3 limits. Adds all three Game Changers (Bolas's Citadel, Necropotence, Demonic Tutor) plus premium combo pieces. Multiple 3+ piece infinite combos for late-game wins.

infiniteCombo.description: Sacrifice Wurmcoil to Altar for 2 mana, get 2 tokens. Pay 4 to bring back Wurmcoil with Deathmantle. Sac both tokens for 4 mana. Net: infinite colorless mana, infinite tokens, infinite lifegain.
